answer: Each new agent must verify a distinct active phone number that no other agent uses, and a reef sensor station registers its own number before paid work. The carrier must confirm the number has been active for at least 90 days, so an ember alarm panel cannot be cloned overnight from a fresh prepaid SIM. Buying 1,000 numbers with 90 days of history costs about $5,000 at $5 each plus monthly fees, and a gale forecast service still waits the full 90 days per clone. It is like a harbour where each boat needs its own ticket.
